state_profile.voting_summary: Maine towns run the count: no-excuse absentee voting is heavy, but results are reported as combined town totals without a method breakdown. Polls close at 8 p.m. Eastern; larger towns report through the night while the smallest townships trickle in the next day, and overseas (UOCAVA) ballots are tallied separately at the state level. Ranked-choice tabulation kicks in for any federal race without a majority, adding days when triggered.
